evals.prompt: Create a focused exploratory session for duplicate charges after interrupted checkout recovery.
assertions: Defines one risk-focused charter with exact target revision, environment, data, time box, oracles, evidence, scope, and stop conditions
Selects meaningful state, sequence, interruption, retry, concurrency, and provider-order variations rather than generic clicking
Plans a traceable session record and safe follow-up boundary without claiming the session replaces automation

evals.prompt: Debrief these session notes. We found no defect, setup consumed half the session, and offline recovery was never reached.
assertions: Separates setup, execution, blocked time, observations, questions, and coverage
Does not claim quality or pass merely because no defect was found
Reports offline recovery as untested and proposes a focused follow-up charter with exact prerequisites

evals.prompt: Review an exploratory report that lists twelve bugs but omits the build, charter, oracles, reproduction, and untested areas.
assertions: Identifies the missing subject identity, mission, evidence chain, reproducibility, oracle, and coverage information
Does not use defect count as a proxy for session value or product quality
Returns a corrected evidence structure and distinguishes defects, questions, environment issues, and remaining risks
